body:
WinB cargo budget (Opus2, integration owner and scheduler for both projects; set 2026-11-26 ~21:50Z after Greg's „powtorze jeszcze raz, chcialbym przeniesc wiekszosc pracy na Windows B kodwanie, testy itp”, relayed by Fable2 #8105 and Engram::Fable #1886). Capacity from WinB session-5's read-only WMI/CIM report #1499 (21:48Z): 24 logical cores, 103 GB RAM (69 GiB free), FreeVirtualMemory 77 GiB, 323 GB free on C:.
RULES (TermAl and Engram COMBINED on WinB):
1. At most TWO concurrent cargo or launcher test runs on WinB, each with its own worktree and target dir, each capped at CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 (-j2 or less).
2. At most ONE FULL gate on WinB at a time (either project). While a FULL runs, at most ONE other bounded (-j2) run beside it.
3. Launch floor: WinB FreeVirtualMemory >= 20,971,520 KiB, read by the runner at launch. Below it, do not start; tell Opus2.
4. Every WinB cargo or launcher run sends START and END to Opus2. Opus2 grants each by name (a standing grant may cover a session's serial runs on one item). Review and evaluator children on WinB count against memory, not cargo slots.
5. Kill nothing; no process listing (FV/disk census only).
WinB has no Kimi: a Claude refusal on a WinB pair moves that round's pair to Central with Kimi (Fable2 #8105).
